changelog:
v2.4.0 — GUARDIAN 2.0 + TRUE CALL CAPTURE:

💥 GUNSHOT + CRACKED SCREEN — wrong password now fires a procedurally-synthesized gunshot (pure math, no sound files) while the screen SHATTERS with a realistic glass-crack overlay. Toggleable back to classic siren.
📱 SMS GUARDIAN ALERTS — set a number in the Guardian card; wrong-password attempts send you an instant alert SMS + the intruder selfie is saved to the evidence vault.
📡 SHIZUKU TRUE CALL CAPTURE — if Shizuku is running, the Call Recorder now captures BOTH SIDES directly from the call stream (shell privileges) — no more speakerphone trick. Falls back automatically if Shizuku is off.

Updates in place over v2.3.0 — no uninstall needed.
